HeroOneSection.CarreerDescription: Senior Full Stack Engineer · Backend & AI-Agentic Development

About.Title: Full Stack Engineer with 15+ years building backend systems and the products on top of them, working with AI agents as part of everyday engineering.
About.Description: I work mostly in Go, Java/Kotlin and Node.js/TypeScript with React, on AWS and GCP. Today I contract for Rappi, on accounts-payable reconciliation for Rappi Turbo in six countries, and for Justo, on last-mile routing and logistics in Mexico. Before that I spent nearly 7 years at Chiper, a Series B B2B marketplace, growing from Backend Engineer to QA Automation Lead to Senior Full Stack Engineer & DevOps Lead, where I led the e-commerce re-platforming in Go. I orchestrate coding agents, put automated review gates in front of every PR and write contracts first, so I can ship more without lowering the bar, and I test what I build and take it to production myself.

ServicesSection.title: Core Competencies
ServicesSection.text0: Go, Java/Spring Boot, Kotlin and Node.js services with hexagonal and Clean Architecture, event-driven messaging (Kafka, SQS, Pub/Sub) and zero-downtime migrations out of legacy monoliths.
ServicesSection.text1: Orchestrated coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor), LLM review gates before every PR and spec-first contracts. Also LLM features in products, like this site's chatbot.
ServicesSection.text2: React and Next.js front ends, CI/CD, Docker and Kubernetes on AWS and GCP, feature flags and test automation, so features reach production end to end.
